decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - Details of the exact location of the door and relationship with the surrounding window, including details of materials, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing prior to works commencing to the building itself. The development shall only be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 3 - The existing bricks shall be re-used in the new boundary wall, details of the pointing shall be submitted to and approved in writing prior to the construction of the wall.
Condition : 4 - Details of the material to be used in the hard surfaced area to be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority prior to the hard surfacing being laid out.

Condition : 5 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
description: Installation of new entrance to building including new gate to boundary wall and internal refurbishments
